todos: [P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: Live full-task results of 2026-09-26 after the audit. qwen3-coder:30b run audit-20260926c: VERIFIED, 8/8 milestones, 37/50 steps, about 53 min, median prompt eval 5.0 s and median step 21 s (qwen3.8 on 2026-09-25: 57.9 s and 128 s); installs approved, build fixed after 3 failures (snapshot %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*audit-20260926c*). Run audit-20260926b (before the stall fix) closed on transport_budget: Ollama sends nothing while a tool call is generated and a 1193-token write at 3.95 tok/s hit the fixed 5-minute stall limit twice (now speed-based). qwen3.8:27b: run audit-20260926 was stopped by the assistant at step 5 to fix the transcript; step 1-2 telemetry showed num_ctx 65536, 83% CPU / 17% GPU, a full 37 s prompt re-evaluation at step 2 and 1092 thinking tokens at about 2.85 tok/s (6.4 min per turn with the model's default 'medium' thinking). A direct probe (%USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\audit\cacheprobe-20260926.mjs) showed qwen3.8 does reuse its cache both when appending and when replacing the trailing message (4.4 s / 6.8 s vs 40.9 s cold), so the step-2 miss is still unexplained: suspect the rendering of the assistant thinking in history (think omitted = model default). Run audit-20260926b with the append-only transcript was stopped at the user's request before any telemetry. Next: rerun qwen3.8 with a unique ONLYRAG_LIVE_RUN, check per-turn promptEvalDurationMs from step 2 on; if misses persist, compare with modelThinkingPreferences['qwen3.8:27b']='low' or false and with thinking stripped from history. The other live workspaces were removed on 2026-09-26; fulltask_qwen3-8-27b-audit-20260926 and -audit-20260926b under %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live are kept as evidence for the step-2 cache miss (their history files are not in any backup) and are disposable once the rerun is analysed.

[P2] AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-03: Partly done and committed (b4a5b30 plus the follow-up commit), no live run by user choice. Done: electron/core/domain/agent/diagnosticAdvice.ts (DiagnosticAdvice; renderAdvice for tool results, renderOrder only inside planDirectiveArbiter, parseRenderedAdvice, ORDER_MARKER); compilerDiagnosticDirective (buildDiagnosticFixAdvice), testFailureDiagnostic, dependencyVersionReality (buildVersionRealityNote, pendingManifestAdvice), moduleResolutionDiagnostic, npmVersionNotFound, npmResolutionConflict, installVersionDowngrade, redundantWriteDetector and the processToolService missing-dependency and auto-healing texts return advice; the arbiter consumes verificationFailureAdvice, behaviorFailureAdvice and pendingManifestAdvice. Verified after the change: typecheck, quality:static, audit:deadcode, audit:cycles, docs:check, test:fast (276 files, 2188 tests) and test:e2e:electron (8 + 9). The advice/order split is documented (docs/agent-guards.md#consigli-e-ordini, agent-runtime.md, agent-diagnostics.md); keep the list of modules still emitting orders there in sync. Still to do: convert the remaining tool-result orders (loopDetector interventions, dependencyIntegrityGate, importDeclarationGate, milestoneUpdateAuthority, milestoneVerificationPromotion, verificationGatePolicy, transactionalExecutionGuard, writeFileTool directory refusal, processToolService dev-server and tool-as-shell blocks, circuit-breaker directory notices, finish and loop guard interventions, webResearchTools); add a source-scan invariant test (no ORDER_MARKER outside the arbiter modules); resolve the turn-1 double order: agentOrchestratorPromptAssembly.ts (assembleTurnPrompt) prepends buildExplicitFirstCommandDirective to compileProgressPrompt({ directive }), so a user-mandated first command and the arbiter's directive (e.g. dependencies_missing, or the focus block's Directives) reach the model as two orders; move it into resolvePlanDirective as the highest-priority turn-1 decision (new kind, with its context and tool policy); review the guards that never fired in 67 live snapshots for removal; confirm with a live full-task run.

[P3] AGENT-DEV-SERVER-TOOL-01: No background-process tool or port probe for dev servers: run_command refuses them (BLOCKING_DEV_SERVER_BLOCK) and the model is told to leave the start to the user. Deferred by the user on 2026-09-26 until it can be designed together with a live run.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log carries structured localized keys (shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, English in src/i18n/locales/en.ts agentMain) with the Italian text as logMessage fallback. On 2026-09-26 every tool result producer was migrated through the toolLog helper of toolExecutionContracts.ts (filesystem, web, Git, recovery, process preconditions, ensure_tool, policy and visual validation), and the fixed-language orchestrator emitLog lines (final verification, workspace error, preflight, execution guard, skill router/hub, plan seeding, session timeout). Deliberately left as they are: 'Task Finished:' and the AI Agent Question marker (parsed by agentLogMessageUtils/AgentTimelineMessage), the bracket markers kept inside the localized texts ([SECURITY BLOCK] etc., used for categories) and diagnosticsToolService's 'Agent Question:'. Remaining: sessionDebtTracker markdown (SESSION_TRACKER.md is fed back to the model, so changing it needs a live run), and the Sidecar chunk prefix [Documento: ... | Sezione: ...] (requires a re-index migration).

[P3] SHELL-CWD-SHORTPATH-01: PersistentPowerShellSession.currentDirectory reports the long path, while a workspace opened through an 8.3 short name (e.g. under a TEMP like C:UsersRUNNER~1) keeps the short one; structuredCommandSafety.inspectStructuredCommand then finds the shell outside the workspace and resolves relative paths from the workspace root instead of the cd target. Safe (root resolution is never less restrictive) but it loses cd tracking; normalize both with fs.realpathSync.native in Application or Infrastructure (Domain cannot touch the filesystem). Found through the CI runner on 2026-09-26.
